title: Light Through Water
statement: I write shaders for games, and I have spent years trying to get one thing right: the dancing net of light at the bottom of a swimming pool. An AI and I built this world together.

fragments.title: Caustics
fragments.text: Light bends at a moving surface and gathers into bright threads below. Physically it is just refraction. Emotionally it is summer at age seven.

fragments.title: The fake that feels right
fragments.text: The most accurate simulation looked dead. A cheap trick with two scrolling noise textures felt alive. Art lives in that gap between correct and true.

fragments.title: Pairing with a machine
fragments.text: My AI collaborator proposed the wave pattern, I tuned the colours until they matched the memory. Neither of us would have made this alone.
